children: flyadeal, Saudia Group’s fast-growing low-cost carrier, will showcase its contribution to Saudi Arabia’s tourism ambitions at World Travel Market (WTM) Riyadh, taking place from September 8–10, 2026.

The airline will highlight its expanding domestic and international network, which connects major cities, emerging destinations and global markets while making travel across the Kingdom more accessible and affordable.
As Saudi Arabia’s tourism sector continues to grow, flyadeal’s expanding fleet and route network are supporting greater visitor access to cultural, heritage, leisure and nature attractions.
The carrier will also showcase its customer-focused approach, competitive fares and efforts to enhance the passenger experience from booking through arrival.

Sanjiv Kapoor, Acting Chief Executive Officer, flyadeal and Executive Vice President Strategies at Saudia Group, said : “Saudi Arabia is undergoing an exciting transformation, with tourism playing a central role in the Kingdom’s growth story. Saudi Arabia offers some of the most unique and exciting tourism opportunities and destinations in the world today, and at flyadeal, we are proud to support this transformation in tourism, by connecting travellers to more destinations across Saudi Arabia and beyond. Through our expanding network served by a fleet of 47 Airbus A320 aircraft, multiple bases, affordable fares and focus on customer experience, we are helping make travel more accessible while contributing to the Kingdom’s tourism ambitions.”

title: ZAWYA: flyadeal showcases expanding network, tourism support at WTM Riyadh
